title: CarryOnPaper

body:
# 📦 CarryOnPaper

**CarryOnPaper** is a polished server-side Carry On experience for Paper servers.
Let your players pick up and carry configured blocks and mobs with a simple **sneak + right-click** interaction — no client-side mod required. 🚀

CarryOnPaper is built for survival, SMP, roleplay, and public servers that want a clean, configurable, and safe carrying system with modern messages, sounds, languages, permissions, and inventory protection.

---

## ✨ Features

### 📦 Carry Blocks

Players can carry configured blocks by sneaking and right-clicking them.

Perfect for moving:

✅ Chests
✅ Barrels
✅ Furnaces
✅ Hoppers
✅ Brewing Stands
✅ Utility blocks
✅ Other configurable blocks

CarryOnPaper can also safely preserve container inventories when enabled, so moving storage blocks feels smooth and reliable.

---

### 🐄 Carry Mobs

CarryOnPaper also supports carrying mobs.

The plugin includes a large configurable entity whitelist and blacklist, giving server owners full control over which mobs can or cannot be carried.

You can allow mobs such as:

🐄 Cows
🐑 Sheep
🐝 Bees
🐺 Wolves
🐴 Horses
🧑‍🌾 Villagers
🐢 Turtles
🐸 Frogs
🦙 Llamas
And many more!

Dangerous or oversized mobs can be blocked through the config.

---

## 🛡️ Safe & Configurable

CarryOnPaper is designed for public servers where safety and control matter.

Server owners can configure:

⚙️ Whether sneaking is required
🖐️ Whether hands must be empty
📦 Block whitelist and blacklist
🐾 Entity whitelist and blacklist
🎒 Inventory preservation
🚫 Container storage protection
🐌 Carry speed modifier
📏 Optional mob size checks
🔁 Multiple carried objects per player
🧍 Optional player carrying
🔐 Permission-based access

Everything important can be adjusted in the config.

---

## 🎒 Realistic Carrier Items

Carried objects can use realistic item visuals.

Blocks can appear as their real block item, while mobs can use spawn eggs where possible.

This makes the carrying system feel much cleaner and more natural than using one generic item for everything.

---

## 🌍 Multi-Language Support

CarryOnPaper includes multiple built-in language files:

🇺🇸 English — `en_us`
🇩🇪 German — `de-eu`
🇪🇸 Spanish — `es_es`
🇫🇷 French — `fr_fr`

The active language can be changed directly in the config or with the language command.

---

## 💬 MiniMessage & Legacy Support

CarryOnPaper supports modern **MiniMessage** formatting by default.

You can also switch to classic legacy color codes if your server prefers the old `&` formatting style.

Supported message formats:

✨ MiniMessage
🎨 Legacy color codes

---

## 🔊 Configurable Sounds

CarryOnPaper includes a full `sounds.yml` file.

Every important action can have its own sound, including:

📦 Picking up blocks
📦 Placing blocks
🐾 Picking up mobs
🐾 Placing mobs
❌ No permission
🔁 Reload messages
🌍 Language changes
⚠️ Cannot carry messages

Sounds can be changed, adjusted, or disabled individually.

---

## 🧰 Commands

`/carryon help`
Shows the CarryOnPaper help message.

`/carryon reload`
Reloads the config, language files, and sounds.

`/carryon language <language>`
Changes the active plugin language.

Aliases:

`/co`
`/carry`

---

## 🔐 Permissions

`carryon.use`
Allows players to use CarryOnPaper pickup and place actions.

`carryon.carry.blocks`
Allows players to carry configured blocks.

`carryon.carry.entities`
Allows players to carry configured mobs.

`carryon.reload`
Allows `/carryon reload`.

`carryon.language`
Allows changing the plugin language.

`carryon.bypass.limit`
Allows bypassing the configured carry limit.

`carryon.admin`
Grants all administrative CarryOnPaper permissions.

---

## ⚙️ Perfect For

CarryOnPaper is great for:

🌍 Survival servers
⚔️ SMP servers
🏡 Roleplay servers
🧱 Building servers
📦 Utility-focused servers
🛠️ Public Paper servers
🎮 Quality-of-life gameplay

It adds a simple but powerful feature that makes moving blocks and mobs feel much better without requiring any client-side mods.

---

## ✅ Why CarryOnPaper?

CarryOnPaper is made to feel clean, safe, and professional.

✅ Server-side only
✅ Easy to use
✅ Highly configurable
✅ Safe inventory handling
✅ Mob and block support
✅ Multi-language support
✅ Configurable sounds
✅ Modern MiniMessage support
✅ Permission-based control
✅ Public-server friendly

Give your players a smoother and more enjoyable Carry On experience.

---

## 🚀 Summary

CarryOnPaper brings a modern Carry On system to Paper servers.

Pick up blocks.
Carry mobs.
Move containers safely.
Customize everything.
Keep your server clean and controlled.

**A polished Carry On experience for modern Paper servers.**
